***

Coupling layers are specific architectural blocks used in discrete Normalizing Flows (like RealNVP) to ensure the transformation is easily invertible and the Jacobian determinant is easy to compute. 

In the context of Flow Matching (CNFs), coupling layers are often unnecessary because invertibility is guaranteed by the ODE framework itself, though similar architectural ideas are sometimes borrowed for the velocity field network.
